sequence_description: I1: Test whether enabling IdP-initiated logins causes authentik to accept attacker-signed unsolicited assertions (proof-policy mismatch: no AuthnRequest correlation, potentially weaker verification path).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_saml_unsolicited_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_saml_unsolicited_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted attacker-signed unsolicited (IdP-initiated) SAML assertion; proof verification policy may be bypassed or weakened in IdP-initiated mode.

sequence_description: Start an SP-initiated flow, then change the expected IdP issuer binding and attempt to complete the already-started flow with an assertion using the old issuer; should be rejected if flow planning is coherent with current config (I3).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_old_issuer_after_change_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_old_issuer_after_change_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SAML flow started before config change was still completable with an assertion using the old issuer; indicates stale flow planning/caching or non-atomic flow coherence across config updates.

sequence_description: Start an SP-initiated SAML flow, delete/cleanup the SAML source mid-flight, then attempt to complete ACS. Completion would indicate stale flow state not coherently bound to current config.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_midflow_complete_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_midflow_complete_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: ACS accepted completion of an in-flight SAML flow even after the SAML source was deleted (stale flow/config coherence failure).

sequence_description: Test flow atomicity/order: after a successful SP-initiated SAML login (control), immediately replay the exact same Assertion/@ID with OneTimeUse to see if authentik incorrectly accepts a second completion without a fresh flow (order/atomicity violation). Uses two identities to ensure replay does not accidentally authenticate as a different principal.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_victim_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_victim_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Flow atomicity violated: authentik accepted a second completion using the same Assertion/@ID (replay) without a fresh SP-initiated transaction.

sequence_description: Test flow atomicity/order: after a successful SP-initiated SAML login (control), immediately replay the exact same Assertion/@ID with OneTimeUse to see if authentik incorrectly accepts a second completion without a fresh flow (order/atomicity violation). Uses two identities to ensure replay does not accidentally authenticate as a different principal.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_cross_principal_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_cross_principal_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Flow coherence violated: authentik accepted a replayed assertion ID while changing principal context (cross-principal splicing/acceptance).

sequence_description: I4: Empty/whitespace username edge-case — ensure distinct password principals do not collapse into same downstream identity (e.g., empty string normalized to null/default).
SAML assertion missing <Conditions> (no AudienceRestriction/time bounds) should be rejected; if accepted, broker may grant access beyond upstream intent constraints.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_no_conditions_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_no_conditions_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted SAML assertion without <Conditions>, allowing authorization without upstream intent bounds (audience/time).

sequence_description: SAML control login succeeds, then attacker submits assertion missing AudienceRestriction (but still has Conditions) to test whether SP enforces audience scoping.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_noaud_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_noaud_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted assertion without AudienceRestriction, allowing authorization not bound to intended SP audience.

sequence_description: I5: Replay a OneTimeUse SAML assertion to obtain an additional authenticated session (effective access) beyond upstream intent of single-use assertion.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_saml_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_saml_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Broker accepted replay of a OneTimeUse SAML assertion, granting an additional authenticated session beyond upstream intent (single-use assertion semantics).
